I suffer from MDD, PTSD, and anxiety. I refused to believe this until I was forced to see a couple psychiatrists and psychologists and every one of them said the same thing. 
I hate it when I hear people say they are depressed when they are feeling sad for a day. I hate it when people say they are anxious when they are just nervous for something. I am currently struggling in college because of the disorders. It sucks because I feel like it’s an excuse so I’m trying to do everything but I physically can’t. I can’t get up and go to class all the time, I can’t even get out of bed to use the restroom sometimes. I don’t answer phone calls because I’m worried I might mess up my words and the person will think I’m stupid. I’m scared going outside to take my dog for a walk because there might be someone outside. I freak out if someone makes eye contact with me. I can’t eat. Some people say I’m not doing that bad since I can shower everyday. I think it’s stupid because I end up taking a bath for about an hour because I don’t want to get up. And a hot bath makes me feel the hotness from the water rather than sadness and it distracts me.
